Question Choices: Fill: A quadrilateral with four right angles and all sides equal in length is most specifically called a ________. (square or rectangle or rhombus)
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus; four right angles make a rectangle; both conditions make a square.
Solution: Four equal sides and four right angles give the most specific name square. A square is also a rectangle, rhombus and parallelogram, but those broader names do not require both conditions.

Question Choices: Fill: A four-sided parallelogram with all sides equal but no right angles is most specifically called a ________. (rhombus or square or trapezoid)
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus; four right angles make a rectangle; both conditions make a square.
Solution: All four sides match, making a rhombus. With no right angles it cannot be a rectangle or square. A parallelogram alone need not have equal sides.

Question Choices: Select. Which shape must have BOTH pairs of opposite sides parallel and ALL four sides the same length? ~~Rectangle | Rhombus | Trapezoid~~
Hints: Check opposite parallel sides, right angles and equal side lengths; a shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Every rhombus has four equal sides and two parallel opposite pairs. A rectangle need not have four equal sides, and a trapezoid need not have two parallel pairs.

Question Choices: True or False: Every square is also a rhombus, but not every rhombus is a square.
Hints: Check opposite parallel sides, right angles and equal side lengths; a shape may belong to several families.
Solution: A square has four equal sides, so it is a rhombus. A rhombus with 65-degree and 115-degree angles has no right angles and is not a square; the statement is true.

Question Choices: Select. A quadrilateral is drawn so that both pairs of opposite sides are parallel, and all angles are right angles. What is the BEST name for this shape?: ~~Square | Rectangle | Rhombus | Parallelogram~~
Hints: Check opposite parallel sides, right angles and equal side lengths; a shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Four right angles guarantee a rectangle and thus a parallelogram. All sides are not stated equal, so a square or rhombus is not guaranteed. Rectangle is the most specific guaranteed name.
